turns.user_message: Write a job post for a senior network engineer.

steps.reasoning: The user asks to write a job post for a senior network engineer. No data retrieval needed. Just produce text. According to rules, can just respond with text. No need for files unless they want. Provide a job posting.
steps.text:
**Senior Network Engineer – Probler Data Center (Remote / On‑site)** **Location:** - Primary data‑center sites: {{city:1}}, TX, or remote (US‑based) with occasional on‑site visits (up to {{int:8:12}} days/month). **About Us** Probler is a leading provider of hyper‑scale data‑center solutions, powering cloud, AI, and high‑performance computing workloads for Fortune‑{{int:400:600}} customers worldwide. Our network infrastructure spans thousands of routers, switches, firewalls, and load‑balancers across multiple continents. We’re building the next generation of software‑defined, automated, and secure networking platforms – and we need a seasoned engineer to lead the charge. **Role Overview** The Senior Network Engineer will own the design, deployment, and operation of our core and edge networking fabric. You will work closely with architecture, security, and operations teams to deliver highly available, high‑performance, and secure connectivity for compute, storage, and Kubernetes workloads. This is a hands‑on role that blends deep technical expertise with strategic thinking and mentorship. **Key Responsibilities** | Area | Responsibilities | |------|-------------------| | **Network Architecture & Design** | • Lead design of data‑center spine‑leaf, WAN, and hybrid cloud networking solutions.
• Evaluate and recommend emerging technologies (e.g., EVPN‑VXLAN, Segment Routing, SD‑WAN, programmable ASICs). | | **Implementation & Automation** | • Deploy and configure enterprise‑grade routers, switches, firewalls (Cisco, Arista, Juniper, Palo‑Alto, etc.).
• Build and maintain Infrastructure‑as‑Code (IaC) pipelines using Ansible, Terraform, and Python/Go scripts. | | **Operations & Reliability** | • Own L3/L2 troubleshooting, performance tuning, capacity planning, and incident response (Tier‑2/3).
• Implement proactive monitoring, telemetry (gNMI, NETCONF), and alerting dashboards. | | **Security & Compliance** | • Enforce network segmentation, zero‑trust policies, and secure routing (BGP security, RPKI).
• Ensure compliance with SOC 2, ISO {{int:21600:32402}}, and GDPR networking requirements. | | **Collaboration & Mentorship** | • Partner with Cloud, Compute, and Storage teams to integrate networking with Kubernetes, GPU clusters, and storage fabrics.
• Mentor junior engineers and lead knowledge‑share sessions. | | **Documentation & Reporting** | • Maintain accurate network diagrams, runbooks, and change‑management records.
• Produce regular status, capacity, and cost‑analysis reports for leadership. | **Required Qualifications** | Requirement | Details | |-------------|----------| | **Experience** | 7+ years of network engineering in large‑scale data‑center or carrier environments. | | **Certifications** | CCIE (Routing & Switching, Data Center, or Service Provider) **or** equivalent (NVIDIA DCA, Juniper JNCIE). | | **Technical Skills** | • Advanced routing (OSPF, IS‑IS, BGP, EVPN).
• Switching (VXLAN, MLAG, FabricPath).
• Network automation (Ansible, Terraform, Python, Go).
• Monitoring/telemetry (Prometheus, Grafana, NetFlow, sFlow, gNMI). | | **Software‑Defined Networking** | Hands‑on with SD‑N controllers (Cisco ACI, Arista CVX, Juniper Contrail) and programmable data planes (P4, eBPF). | | **Kubernetes & Cloud** | Familiarity with CNI plugins (Calico, Cilium), Service Mesh networking, and hybrid‑cloud interconnects. | | **Problem‑Solving** | Proven track record of diagnosing complex multi‑layer network issues under pressure. | | **Communication** | Strong written and verbal skills; ability to convey technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders. | **Preferred Extras** - Experience with GPU‑focused networking (e.g., NVLink, RDMA over Converged Ethernet). - Knowledge of security frameworks (Zero‑Trust, SASE). - Exposure to public‑cloud networking (AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, Google Cloud Interconnect). **What We Offer** - Competitive base salary + performance bonus. - Comprehensive health, dental, vision, and {{int:320:482}}(k) match. - Flexible work model (remote‑first with occasional on‑site collaboration). - Professional development budget for certifications and conferences. - Cutting‑edge lab environment with the latest networking hardware and software. **How to Apply** Submit your resume, a brief cover letter highlighting relevant projects, and any relevant certification numbers to **careers@probler.com** with the subject line: **Senior Network Engineer – [Your Name]**. *Probler is an equal‑opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*
